svg.title: The FIC0 interconnect's slave configuration in Libero, with numbered callouts: slave 0 is AXI-Lite, 32 bit, at 0x60010000 to 0x6001ffff; slave 1 is AXI4, 64 bit, at 0x60000000 to 0x60000fff; the symbol shows one master port in and two slave ports out.
svg.desc: The FIC0 interconnect's slave configuration in Libero, with numbered callouts: slave 0 is AXI-Lite, 32 bit, at 0x60010000 to 0x6001ffff; slave 1 is AXI4, 64 bit, at 0x60000000 to 0x60000fff; the symbol shows one master port in and two slave ports out.

g.text: AXI4, 64 bit wide, addresses 0x60000000 to 0x60000fff; in the canvas it feeds the on-chip SRAM.
One master port in (AXI4mmaster0), two slave ports out (AXI4mslave0 and AXI4mslave1).
